svg.title: Reseller Sourcing and Flipping Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-reseller-four-week-roadmap; chapter number: 12; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Reseller Sourcing and Flipping Roadmap; subtitle: Event selection, presale stacking, cart checks and sell-through tracking; caption: A four-week ramp built on the flipper rule of buying where demand outruns seats, screened against a 25% margin benchmark.; assumptions note: Every purchasing account must map to a real, provable person; methods that beat a seller's purchase limit fall under the BOTS Act at over $53,000 per violation (Hustle Audit, NOBp14Qcy_8 @ 00:06:47).; note: Sources: Ticket Flipping (JwHo6if-9Wo @ 00:09:05; hw92haJDs9Y @ 00:11:21; NGFBVOXqxpA @ 00:04:09), Emmanuel Ak (RsyNgibgVJY @ 00:24:33; ETQnblEeP94 @ 00:32:36), 850 Club Credit (p8CMjg4a_CI @ 00:04:17), The Credit Nerd (JS9sO0Fx9A0 @ 00:02:23).; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Select events where demand outruns seats; deliverable: Shortlist of small-venue, weekend and hometown shows screened with Spotify listeners and live inventory counts.; gate: Each event clears a 25% per-ticket margin benchmark.; week: Week 2; title: Stack every presale; deliverable: Amex, Citi Entertainment and Mastercard presale access mapped; one Amex presale turned $150 floor seats into about $390 resales.; gate: Every presale available for the event has been checked.; week: Week 3; title: Run the cart check; deliverable: StubHub compared while seats sit in the cart; Rush seats at about $300 listed near $570.; gate: Resale spread confirmed before payment.; week: Week 4; title: Track sell-through and stay liquid; deliverable: Remaining tickets divided by capacity daily, watching for held inventory that pushes a 500 count back to 700.; gate: Real daily downtrend, time to receive, list, sell and transfer, and no money tied up in dead stock.
